subject.title: fix(mcp): soft-fail unconfigured tool registry and lock context factory

question: Should unconfigured ToolRegistry.allTools change from a documented fatal programming error to an empty-list soft failure, or should recoverable startup stay limited to explicit throwing MCP server paths?
rationale: Current docs and main behavior intentionally make missing installAgentRuntimeDefaults a programming error, while this PR changes one public default path to recoverable empty output; that compatibility contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept soft-fail with proof
options.body: Allow unconfigured ToolRegistry probes to return an empty list, but require actual runtime proof and docs that describe the new behavior before merge.

options.title: Keep strict registry defaults
options.body: Preserve the fatal default for ToolRegistry and keep recoverable behavior only in explicit throwing startup helpers such as makeDefaultIfConfigured.

options.title: Pause for API direction
options.body: Hold the PR until the runtime owner decides the permanent missing-default contract for MCP and ToolRegistry callers.

recommendation.title: Accept soft-fail with proof
recommendation.body: Allow unconfigured ToolRegistry probes to return an empty list, but require actual runtime proof and docs that describe the new behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main history owner for the affected AgentRuntime default-factory paths and install-defaults contract.
